item.title: Boom CEO: Powering AI Data Centers Will Speed Path to Supersonic Flights
item.description: Boom Supersonic is now providing turbines to data centers to help fuel the AI boom. The company’s CEO says the move won’t detract from its ambitions of reviving supersonic flight.

item.title: TUI Group Targets Nearly $300 Million in Cost Cuts
item.description: Artificial intelligence will play a role in TUI Group’s efforts to bring down costs within its markets and airline division.

item.title: India’s $72 Billion Wedding Season Is Reshaping Travel, Again
item.description: With every passing year, the budgets for Indian weddings are increasing as couples seek to make their big day more aligned to their personal tastes. Hotels, villas, palaces - all stand to benefit.

item.title: IndiGo Chairman Admits Failures, Rejects Claims Airline ‘Engineered’ Meltdown
item.description: For IndiGo, the past week exposed how quickly a large, tightly scheduled network can unravel, and how hard it is to restore confidence once it does. The airline’s brand has long been built on punctuality and predictability. The scale and speed of this disruption challenge both.

item.title: JetBlue’s First Lounge to Debut at JFK: Here’s a Look Inside
item.description: JetBlue’s first-ever lounge is bigger than expected and is stylish. Some won't like the grab-and-go food, but a kitchen with hot meals is coming.

item.title: 3 Ways Corporate Meetings in New Orleans Can Fuel Creativity
item.description: Beyond the everyday challenges of organizing memorable events that move the needle for companies, today's planners are under mounting pressure to inspire a burned-out workforce. New Orleans combines its rich history, deep culture, and modern innovation to host corporate experiences that spark creativity and foster connection.

item.title: LVMH’s Belmond Upgrades Its Hotels While Rivals Chase Scale
item.description: Belmond is renovating its classic luxury hotels rather than playing the game of scaling up fast.

item.title: International Travel to the U.S. Has Dropped for 7 Straight Months
item.description: A full recovery in inbound tourism isn't expected until 2029, and new fees and vetting requirements won't help.

item.title: The Climate Claims Airlines Can No Longer Talk About in Europe
item.description: The EU's crackdown exposes how widespread aviation green claims have become.

item.title: An Existential Threat? Booking Exec Sees AI as an Expansion Opportunity
item.description: Booking's CFO thinks artificial intelligence can put his company on the offensive rather than the defensive. The odds are long but based on past performance you can't count them out.
